summary: Backend + frontend regression validation completed for call/chat/translation batch. Backend APIs passed (4/4 pytest), /api/translate returned fast 200 responses with valid translated_text, call route correctly rendered passed displayName (Asare Ben Chris), and composer tools tap did not crash in preview. Public tunnel preview was intermittently unavailable (502/ngrok timeout), and authenticated multi-device validations remain blocked.

ui_bugs.issue: Public preview URL intermittently returned 502 and 'preview environment is not responding' due ngrok tunnel timeouts.

integration_issues.issue: Code path still risks hiding real online presence: subtitle uses formatPresenceSubtitle(savedContactRecord || conversation), so when a saved contact exists but has no status fields, conversation online/lastSeen data is bypassed.

integration_issues.flow: Caller hangup while ringing -> receiver ringing stop
integration_issues.issue: Code review confirms caller hangup now calls declineCall when status is ringing, but receiver-side ring-stop behavior could not be fully validated without a second signed-in live device/session.

integration_issues.flow: Saved contact names in real conversations
integration_issues.issue: Route-param displayName behavior passed in preview, but end-to-end saved-contact resolution in real authenticated conversation remains unverified in this run.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings persist (expo-notifications web listener limits, expo-av deprecation, shadow/textShadow/pointerEvents deprecations).

action_items: Fix presence subtitle source selection so saved-contact display name can be used without discarding conversation presence/online fields.
Retest caller hangup during ringing with two signed-in devices/accounts to confirm receiver ringtone stops immediately.
Retest real authenticated conversation to verify saved contact names render across chat header and call screen without fallback to generic labels.
Stabilize public Expo tunnel startup/retries (ngrok timeout issue) so public-endpoint UI validation is reliable.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx`: `subtitle` currently passes `savedContactRecord || conversation` into presence formatter; this can suppress real conversation online/last-seen data when contact object lacks status fields.
`/app/frontend/app/call/[conversationId].tsx`: `handleHangup` correctly uses `declineCall` for `ringing` state, matching requested RCA direction.
`/app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx` remains very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk around composer, translation, and presence side effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated locally on mobile viewport: /call/testconversation1?type=voice&displayName=Asare%20Ben%20Chris shows exact passed name and visible controls; /chat/testconversation1 remains stable with unavailable fallback and tools-button tap did not crash. Public preview URL had intermittent 502/unresponsive tunnel behavior, so local preview was used for UI regression checks.
rca_of_issue: RCA-1 (presence subtitle): subtitle prioritizes savedContactRecord object for formatting, but that object usually contains identity fields only; presence fields are on conversation/otherUser, causing online/last-seen degradation. RCA-2 (public preview instability): expo supervisor logs show repeated ngrok tunnel connection timeouts, matching observed 502/unresponsive public preview page during automation. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
